Israel now faces added internal strain after the government’s 5 July decision to defy a Supreme Court ruling on the broadcast regulator, pushing a judicial confrontation into open view. The regional picture is one of governments asserting authority through spectacle or institutional force while civilians absorb the costs of war, repression, and political uncertainty.
